targets.authors: Smith, S., Van Tubergen, F., Maas, I., & McFarland, D. A.
targets.title: Ethnic composition and friendship segregation: differential effects for adolescent natives and immigrants.
targets.evidence_quote: This reproduction tests the claim from Smith et al. (2016) that classrooms with a larger share of natives show less ethnic homophily.
targets.outcome_computational_quote: Our replication of Model 2 in Table 3  yields a coefficient of  b = -.47 (SE = .07, p < .001) on  the “Proportion natives” variable (see Table 1 in the attached Appendix).  Thus, this reproduction of the claim was successful according to the SCORE criteria.
targets.outcome_robustness_quote: Overall, across all of our models, we find a negative, statistically significant (p < .01) coefficient on “Proportion natives” that is similar in size to the coefficient reported in the original study.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Re-analysis of the original CILS4EU wave-1 data using a newer release and reconstructed procedures. Comparable estimates differ from the original b=-.51, SE=.06, beyond rounding; authors judge substantive replication successful and all inclusion-rule robustness checks support it. Computation axis uncertain because exact numerical recovery was not the stated success criterion and deviations were deliberate.

reasoning: Final report identity matches OSF project and Gereke team. Original-data re-analysis despite without-author-data project label. Reference copied from report; no DOI printed.
